knowledge_cards.claim: Paper results use 32 steps with contextual MIDI; released defaults use 16 steps without contextual MIDI.
Step-count ablations show competing metric optima, not a universal optimum.
Source-only normalization avoids target leakage but does not guarantee output headroom after inverse scaling.
Outside-sample identity is relative to the resampled mono crop, not original multichannel audio.
Target MIDI is used inside the mask; source context MIDI is optional and off by default.
Fine40 aliases multiple GM programs, making some apparent timbre edits conditioning-equivalent.
FlowEdit identical-MIDI equality is structural and does not validate ordinary regeneration.
CFG MIDI dropout removes every fragment of a crossing physical note.
The 128-row frame capacity fails closed and should be preflighted.
Code commit pinning does not pin mutable model downloads or remote pipeline code.
Mocked tests validate interfaces and algebra, not real-checkpoint audio safety or preference.
MambaVoice remains reproduction-blocked while its linked repository returns 404.
